concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-capital-renew-grant]] — 2026-09-15 pilot guide for partially repaid grant renewal, minimum/offer and renewed-ToS gates, prior/subsequent IDs, asynchronous request and separate grant/transfer/payout observations.
warnings: Grant renewal is pilot-only in this snapshot and separately eligibility-gated; one disbursement per grant is documented.
The page says full new amount is disbursed and prior outstanding principal reserved for repayment, but this page does not prove actual settlement of a user's prior balance or actual new payout.

Test snippets are not an internally consistent single transaction: example minimumAmount.value 9440625 exceeds illustrated transfer amount 1850000, and outer/nested grant identifiers vary; do not infer a universal join or qualifying amount.
